claims.value: DeepSeek-V3 is a MoE language model with 671B total parameters and 37B activated per token. It adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures. It pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free load balancing strategy and uses a multi-token prediction training objective. Pre-trained on 14.8T tokens with Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning.
claims.evidence: DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated
ModalityTextIn, ModalityTextOut, CapChat, CapFunctionCall, CapJsonMode are implied by the model being a chat model, though not explicitly listed as registry constants
